title: CapabilityResultEnvelope
description: The single result shape every QianPulse capability returns. A3/A4/A5 are emitted only by their authoritative Python runtimes through scripts/capability_cli.py; Node routes, validates, traces, and persists the envelope without reproducing domain semantics.

capability_version.description: Capability or ruleset version. Runtime failures use runtime-error.

run_status.description: DONE / NOT_APPLICABLE / BLOCKED count as refreshed; MORE_EVIDENCE waits for evidence; ERROR indicates infrastructure or invalid runtime output.

domain_result.description: Capability-specific payload. Conventional keys: A3 { purchase_window, timing_signal, readiness, timing_score }; A4 { match_status, supply_pool_status, best_verdict, best_fit_score, summary_zh }; A5 { status, decision, destination, market_access }. The integration layer adds capability_runtime='python' and source='python' provenance; infrastructure failures return ERROR instead of a semantic fallback.
